Morning.text_cn: 瑞气临门春作序     Ruì qì lín mén chūn zuò xù     ,

Morning.text_cn: 祥云入户福登台     Xiáng yún rù hù fú dēng tái

Morning.speaker: Amy
Morning.text_cn: 四海同胞齐欢聚     Sì hǎi tóng bāo qí huān jù

Morning.speaker: Amy
Morning.text_cn: 里城华人共开怀     Lǐ chéng huá rén gòng kāi huái

Morning.speaker: Chris
Morning.text_cn: 女士们，先生们，小朋友们， 大家~~

Morning.speaker: Jason
Morning.text_cn: 欢迎来到由美华协会 维中分会 主办的 里士满 2026 马年 春节联欢会!

Morning.speaker: Evan
Morning.text_cn: Ladies and Gentlemen, Welcome to the Richmond 2026 Year of the Horse  Lunar New Year Celebration, hosted by the OCA Asian Pacific American Advocates, Central Virginia Chapter, OCA-CVC.

Morning.speaker: 多多
Morning.text_cn: On behalf of the OCA-CVC, we wish everyone a Happy Spring Festival and a prosperous Year of the Horse!

Morning.speaker: Emeline
Morning.text_cn:
美华协会 维中分会，是一个501(c)非盈利组织，致力于改善华裔和其他亚太裔美国人的生活。
爆竹声声辞旧岁，竹报平安又一年。
我们代表美华协会 维中分会 祝大家新春快乐，马年吉祥！在这里给您～～

Morning.speaker: Jasmine
Morning.text_cn: 在这辞旧迎新的美好时刻，我们用歌声传递祝福，用舞蹈表达喜悦，用真情共庆新春佳节！

Morning.speaker: Chris
Morning.text_cn: At this wonderful moment, we convey our blessings through song, express our joy through dance, and celebrate the Spring Festival together with heartfelt sincerity.

Morning.speaker: Jasmine
Morning.text_cn:
这首歌，在过去一年荣获多项年度大奖，以动人的旋律打动了无数人心。
让我们倾听 维中中文学校 带来的歌曲 《世界赠予我的》。

Morning.speaker: Chris
Morning.text_cn: Please welcome the CVCS Central Virginia Chinese School Choir performing " World Bestowed."

Morning.text: #2 霓裳焰语 Neon Flame Whisper

Morning.speaker: Esther
Morning.text_cn: 下面登场的是 Julianne Woo， 她带来了舞蹈《霓裳焰语》。用舞姿点燃舞台， 热烈与优雅同时绽放。

Morning.speaker: 多多
Morning.text_cn: Next enjoy dance: 'Neon Flame Whisper'，performed by Julianne Woo

Morning.text: #3 独唱《梅花赋》Ode to the Plum Blossom

Morning.speaker: Amy
Morning.text_cn: 疏影横斜水清浅 暗香浮动月黄昏    梅花，傲雪凌霜，与松、竹并称“岁寒三友"

Morning.speaker: Evan
Morning.text_cn: 是的，梅，兰、竹、菊并为“花中四君子”，尽显高洁风骨。

Morning.speaker: Amy
Morning.text_cn: 请欣赏 Qian Junqi 带来的独唱《梅花赋》。

Morning.speaker: Evan
Morning.text_cn:
The plum blossom, one of the “Three Friends of Winter,” symbolizes noble character and steadfast friendship.
Please enjoy Qian Junqi’s new rendition of “Ode to the Plum Blossom.”

Morning.speaker: Emeline
Morning.text_cn: 风，看不见，却无处不在；风，无形，却能撼动人心。

Morning.speaker: Chris
Morning.text_cn: 接下来，Richmond Folk Dance Group 将用舞蹈描绘风的形态与力量。

Morning.speaker: Emeline
Morning.text_cn:
The wind is invisible, yet it is everywhere;
Next, the Richmond Folk Dance Group will use dance to depict the form and power of the wind.

Morning.speaker: Jasmine
Morning.text_cn: 多多, 有没有这样一首中文歌，能够穿越时间，依然打动人心？

Morning.speaker: 多多
Morning.text_cn: 有，它经久不衰，用美好的旋律传递希望。

Morning.speaker: Jesmine
Morning.text_cn: 请欣赏二重唱  《明天会更好》，表演者：Sun Yue & Abing。

Morning.speaker: 多多
Morning.text_cn: Please enjoy the duet " Tomorrow Will Be Better,"  performed by Sun Yue & Abing.

Morning.speaker: Esther
Morning.text_cn:
故园的春天，鸟语花香，光影流转。
请欣赏由Jìn Xiǎo hóng带来的独舞《故园游春》

Morning.speaker: Evan
Morning.text_cn: Next, please enjoy a solo dance performanced by Jin Xiaohong ，Strolling through a garden of memories.

Morning.speaker: Jason
Morning.text_cn: 让歌声带我们穿越时光，重温上海滩的辉煌与传奇！有请 Li Ying  演唱 经典粤语歌曲 《上海滩》。

Morning.speaker: Chris
Morning.text_cn:
Enjoy Li Ying performing the classic “Shanghai Bund,”
and let her voice carry you to the romance and glamour of old Shanghai.

Morning.speaker: Jasmine
Morning.text_cn: Amy，你知道吗？中国人的情感表达，其实特别含蓄。

Morning.speaker: Amy
Morning.text_cn: 正如王维的诗：红豆生南国，春来发几枝？愿君多采撷，此物最相思。

Morning.speaker: Jasmine
Morning.text_cn: 接下来，请欣赏敦煌艺术团带来的舞蹈 《红豆》。

Morning.speaker: Amy
Morning.text_cn: In Chinese culture, red beans symbolize deep longing and yearning. Now, please enjoy the dance "Red Bean" performed by the Dunhuang Art Troupe.

Morning.text: # 9 街舞《主场全开》Take it to the house

Morning.speaker: Emeline
Morning.text_cn: 少年舞者用律动 和爆发动作 点燃节拍，宣告：哪里都是我们的主场！

Morning.speaker: 多多
Morning.text_cn:
请欣赏 Yu Dance Arts 带来的街舞作品 《主场全开》
准备好了吗？一起把氛围带回家！

Morning.speaker: Emeline
Morning.text_cn: Get ready! Take It to the House by Yu Dance Arts，sharp moves, perfect sync, pure energy.  This is their house!

Morning.speaker: Amy
Morning.text_cn: 当东方的古筝遇见西方的吉他，会迸发出怎样的音符火花？

Morning.speaker: Jason
Morning.text_cn: 让我们 随着 East Meet West 的弹唱，踏上《500英里路》的音乐旅程。

Morning.speaker: Amy
Morning.text_cn:
What kind of musical sparks will fly when the Eastern guzheng meets the Western guitar?
Join East Meet West on a musical journey along "500 Miles."

Morning.text:
#11 《露华浓·花想容》
Grace of Blossoms • Radiance of Dew

Morning.speaker: Esther
Morning.text_cn: 云想衣裳花想容，春风拂槛露华浓。Jason， 你知道这是哪位唐代诗人的诗吗

Morning.speaker: Jason
Morning.text_cn: 唐代诗人，我就只知道两个，李白和杜甫，我猜这是李白的诗

Morning.speaker: Esther
Morning.text_cn: 恭喜你，猜对了！接下来的表演是舞蹈《露华浓，花想容》，灵感来源于这首诗，由Zeng’s Dance School呈献。

Morning.speaker: Jason
Morning.text_cn: The next performance is a dance piece titled "Grace of Blossoms • Radiance of Dew" ，presented by Zeng's Dance School.

Morning.speaker: Jason
Morning.text_cn: 中场 休息

Morning.speaker: Jasmine
Morning.text_cn: 春节联欢会上半场节目到此结束，感谢您的观看！请稍作休息，1:00锁定现场，下半场更多精彩，不见不散。

Morning.speaker: Evan
Morning.text_cn: The first half of the Spring Festival Gala has concluded. Thank you for watching. Please take a short break and join us at 1:00 pm for the exciting second half!  See you then!

Afternoon.speaker: all
Afternoon.text_cn: 会长致词

Afternoon.speaker: Emeline
Afternoon.text_cn: 美华协会 维中分会，是一个501(c)非盈利组织，致力于改善华裔和其他亚太裔美国人的生活。

Afternoon.speaker: Jason
Afternoon.text_cn: Organization of Chinese-Americans, Central Virginia chapter, is a 501(c)  membership-driven organization dedicated to the betterment of Chinese and other Asian Pacific Americans

Afternoon.speaker: Emeline
Afternoon.text_cn: OCA CVC 除了开展本地项目外，还支持全国总部的教育和领导力培养项目。

Afternoon.speaker: Jason
Afternoon.text_cn: The local chapter supports OCA National's programs for education, advocacy and leadership, in addition to local programs.

Afternoon.speaker: Emeline
Afternoon.text_cn: 下面有请 维中美华协会主席 刘洁女士致新年贺词

Afternoon.speaker: Jason
Afternoon.text_cn: Now, please welcome Ms. Liu Jie, President of OCA-CVC, to deliver her New Year's greetings.

Afternoon.speaker: Jesmine
Afternoon.text_cn: 春节联欢会上半场的节目精彩纷呈，接下来，下半场的表演马上开始.

Afternoon.speaker: Chris
Afternoon.text_cn: The first half of the Spring Festival Gala was spectacular, and now the exciting performances of the second half are about to begin. Let's look forward to more joy and surprises!

Afternoon.speaker: Jesmine
Afternoon.text_cn: 静谧森林中，阳光透过树影，微风轻语。

Afternoon.speaker: Chris
Afternoon.text_cn: 一只只灵动的小鹿，竖起耳朵，静静聆听

Afternoon.speaker: Jesmine
Afternoon.text_cn: 请欣赏 On The One Dance 带来的舞蹈《聆听》

Afternoon.speaker: Chris
Afternoon.text_cn:
In a tranquil forest, sunlight and breeze whisper. A graceful deer dances with nature,
showing the harmony of humans and all living things.  Please enjoy "Listening," a dance performance by On The One Dance.

Afternoon.speaker: Emeline
Afternoon.text_cn:
童年有歌，童心有梦；请欣赏 Yu Dance Arts 带来的舞蹈 《丢手绢》
在天真烂漫的舞姿中，重温那份追逐的快乐与纯真的笑容！

Afternoon.speaker: 多多
Afternoon.text_cn:
Next, please enjoy the dance performance "Dropping the Handkerchief" by Yu Dance Arts.
Through these innocent and joyful dance movements, relive the happiness of chasing and the pure smiles of childhood!"

Afternoon.text: #14 杨式32 式 太极剑 (Taiji Sword)

Afternoon.speaker: Jason
Afternoon.text_cn: 接下来，里村云华太极 给我们带来了《杨式32式 太极剑》。

Afternoon.speaker: Esther
Afternoon.text_cn: 让我们一同来体悟太极的动静相生， 柔刚并济。

Afternoon.speaker: Jason
Afternoon.text_cn:
Next, please enjoy Yang-style 32-form Tai Chi Sword by Lǐcūn Yún Huá Tai Chi.
Experience the harmony of movement and stillness, where gentle grace meets strength and skill meets inner calm.

Afternoon.speaker: Amy
Afternoon.text_cn: 一缕晨光，唤醒弄堂。身着旗袍的女子，执扇而坐。

Afternoon.speaker: Evan
Afternoon.text_cn: 在袅袅烟火中，平凡的清晨化成了最温柔的诗。

Afternoon.speaker: Amy
Afternoon.text_cn: 请欣赏 Yu Dance Arts 带来的舞蹈《晨光曲》

Afternoon.speaker: Evan
Afternoon.text_cn: Step into 1930s Shanghai — the “Paris of the East,”  where jazz filled the streets and lilong alleys whispered everyday life.   Please enjoy Yu Dance Arts’ performance: “Dawn in Old Shanghai.”

Afternoon.speaker: Jason
Afternoon.text_cn: 台风呼啸，滚滚而来，犹如万马奔腾。请欣赏古筝独奏《战台风》，表演者：Jennifer Ran。

Afternoon.speaker: Chris
Afternoon.text_cn: The typhoon roared in like a stampede of thousands of horses. Please enjoy the guzheng solo "Battling the Typhoon," performed by Jennifer Ran.

Afternoon.speaker: Amy
Afternoon.text_cn: “鹅，鹅，鹅，曲项向天歌”，Esther, 你小时候背过这首唐诗吗

Afternoon.speaker: Esther
Afternoon.text_cn: 背过的，不仅背过，小时候还跳过咏鹅舞呢！

Afternoon.speaker: Amy
Afternoon.text_cn: 看，这里  有  一群  小＂白鹅”  们 在 舞台上翩 翩  展翅

Afternoon.speaker: Esther
Afternoon.text_cn: 她们 用 欢快的舞步，把 古诗 跳进 新年的 喜庆里

Afternoon.speaker: Amy
Afternoon.text_cn: 让我们一起来欣赏  On The One Dance 带来的   "会 跳舞 的 古诗”  《鹅鹅鹅》！

Afternoon.speaker: Esther
Afternoon.text_cn: “Goose, goose, goose, with its graceful neck singing to the sky,” from Luo Binwang’s Ode to the Goose, comes to life on stage.  Please enjoy this “dancing poem” presented by On The One Dance，

Afternoon.speaker: Emeline
Afternoon.text_cn: 秋天，是丰收的季节，也是喜悦的季节！

Afternoon.speaker: 多多
Afternoon.text_cn: 让我们随着风之舞艺术团，走进他们带来的节目 《秋日》。

Afternoon.speaker: Emeline
Afternoon.text_cn: Next, please enjoy the performance of "Autumn" by the Wind Dance Art Troupe.

Afternoon.text: #19 相声《其实不是那么回事》

Afternoon.speaker: Jason
Afternoon.text_cn: Jasmine, 你有没有听过相声？

Afternoon.speaker: Jasmine
Afternoon.text_cn: 相声？ 这个我听过。是一种中国的传统曲艺。

Afternoon.speaker: Jason
Afternoon.text_cn: 没错，就是这门又风趣又充满智慧的艺术。

Afternoon.speaker: Jasmine
Afternoon.text_cn: 接下来请欣赏相声《其实不是那么回事》。

Afternoon.speaker: Jason
Afternoon.text_cn: 那是怎么回事？

Afternoon.speaker: Jasmine
Afternoon.text_cn: 那我们听听到底怎么回事。 有请表演者陶星仰、陶星聿。

Afternoon.speaker: Jason
Afternoon.text_cn:
Crosstalk is a traditional Chinese art blending humor and wisdom.
Please enjoy Tao Xingyang and Tao Xingyu in “It’s Not Quite Like That.”

Afternoon.text:
#20 混声合唱《草原夜色美》Beautiful Night on the Prairie
混声合唱 《月亮代表我的心》The Moon Represents My Heart

Afternoon.speaker: Evan
Afternoon.text_cn: 掌声有请  雅歌合唱团 演唱两首好听的歌曲： 《草原夜色美》  《月亮代表我的心》

Afternoon.speaker: Amy
Afternoon.text_cn: Next, please enjoy two songs performed by the YaGe Choir: "Beautiful Night on the Prairie,"  and "The Moon Represents My Heart"

Afternoon.speaker: Esther
Afternoon.text_cn: Chris，考考你，中国有多少个少数民族？

Afternoon.speaker: Chris
Afternoon.text_cn: 嗯……我知道我是汉族，还知道回族、满族、苗族、朝鲜族……其他的一下子想不出来了。

Afternoon.speaker: Esther
Afternoon.text_cn: 知道的已经不少了！中华民族有汉族和 55 个少数民族，其中，朝鲜族文化独具魅力。

Afternoon.speaker: Chris
Afternoon.text_cn: 请欣赏 Yu Dance Arts 带来的朝鲜族舞蹈《阿里郎》。

Afternoon.speaker: Esther
Afternoon.text_cn:
Next, please welcome Yu Dance Arts’ Teen Diamond class with “Arirang,”
where graceful traditional movements meet modern energy, celebrating the vibrant spirit of China’s Korean community.

Afternoon.text: #22   哈尼宝贝 Hani Baby  敦煌艺术团

Afternoon.speaker: Emeline
Afternoon.text_cn: 当银饰清脆作响，哈尼族的使者们将用纯真的舞步，

Afternoon.speaker: 多多
Afternoon.text_cn: 带我们穿越云雾，感受最炽热的民族心跳！

Afternoon.speaker: Emeline
Afternoon.text_cn: 掌声有请 敦煌艺术团带来的舞蹈《哈尼宝贝》

Afternoon.speaker: 多多
Afternoon.text_cn:
Clinking silver, swirling skirts,  the Hani little messengers take us through the mist, into the vibrant heartbeat of their culture.
Please welcome Dunhuang Arts Troupe with “Hani Baby.”

Afternoon.speaker: Chris
Afternoon.text_cn: 这首中国新美声风格的作品，旋律优美，情感深沉。

Afternoon.speaker: Evan
Afternoon.text_cn: 掌声欢迎  Mary Hao 带来的 女声独唱 《我怎样去爱你》。

Afternoon.speaker: Chris
Afternoon.text_cn:
Next, please enjoy the female solo “How Do I Love You”.
This piece, in the Chinese New Bel Canto style, is beautifully melodic and deeply emotional.
Let’s welcome the performer, Mary Hao!

Afternoon.speaker: Jason
Afternoon.text_cn: 春风作伴，万物生长；

Afternoon.speaker: Amy
Afternoon.text_cn: 让我们以热烈掌声，欢迎里士满东方歌舞团，带来舞蹈 《上春山》！

Afternoon.speaker: Jason
Afternoon.text_cn: Next, let's give a warm round of applause to the Richmond Oriental Dance and Music Troupe, who will present the dance "'Ascending Spring Mountain "

Afternoon.speaker: Esther
Afternoon.text_cn: 青春在旋转中定格，梦想在足尖上绽放。

Afternoon.speaker: 多多
Afternoon.text_cn: 接下来，请欣赏芭蕾变奏《毕业舞会》，表演者：Dehila

Afternoon.speaker: Esther
Afternoon.text_cn: Youth is captured in a moment of graceful rotation, and dreams blossom on the tips of the toes.

Afternoon.speaker: 多多
Afternoon.text_cn: Next, please enjoy the ballet variation "Graduation Ball," performed by Dehila.

Afternoon.text: #26 莲叶翩翩   whispering lotus leave

Afternoon.speaker: Emeline
Afternoon.text_cn: 江南可采莲，莲叶何田田。

Afternoon.speaker: Chris
Afternoon.text_cn: 晨光拂水，莲叶轻舞，荷香盈袖

Afternoon.speaker: Emeline
Afternoon.text_cn: 让我们一同欣赏Yu Dance Arts 带来的中国古典舞《莲叶翩翩》。

Afternoon.speaker: Chris
Afternoon.text_cn:
As morning light caresses the water, lotus leaves sway and fragrance fills the air.
Please enjoy “Whispering Lotus Leaves” by Yu Dance Arts.

Afternoon.speaker: Evan
Afternoon.text_cn: 华人以“吃苦耐劳”闻名世界，同时也热爱生活与艺术。Jasmine, 你听过中国戏曲吗？

Afternoon.speaker: Jasmine
Afternoon.text_cn: 中国戏曲流派众多，其中京剧被誉为“国剧”，与书法、中医、武术并称为四大国粹。接下来请欣赏京剧选段《梨花颂》，表演者：Liu Jie

Afternoon.speaker: Evan
Afternoon.text_cn:
Chinese opera is vast and profound.
Peking Opera, the “national opera,” is one of China’s four great cultural treasures, alongside calligraphy, traditional medicine, and martial arts.  Next, please enjoy an excerpt from Peking Opera – "Ode to Pear Blossoms," performed by Jie Liu.

Afternoon.speaker: Esther
Afternoon.text_cn: 请欣赏 华艺舞团 带来的舞蹈 《茉莉》，轻盈舞姿中，茉莉花的清香与优雅  化作了动人的诗篇。

Afternoon.speaker: 多多
Afternoon.text_cn:
Next, please welcome the Huayi Dance Troupe to perform “Jasmine.”
Through graceful movements, the dancers bring the jasmine’s delicate fragrance and elegance to life.

Afternoon.speaker: Amy
Afternoon.text_cn: 春回大地，百花竞放，宛如一副流动的画卷

Afternoon.speaker: Evan
Afternoon.text_cn: 让我们跟随舞者步伐，走进花海，感受自然的灵动。

Afternoon.speaker: Amy
Afternoon.text_cn: 请欣赏 On The One Dance 带来的舞蹈 《百花争妍》。

Afternoon.speaker: Evan
Afternoon.text_cn:
Please enjoy “Flowers Bloom in Beauty” by On The One Dance,
where dancers’ graceful steps lead us into a vibrant sea of blossoms and the joy of spring.

Afternoon.text: # 30 东方歌舞团合唱   世界赠予我的

Afternoon.speaker: Emeline
Afternoon.text_cn: 上半场第一个节目的歌声还在我耳边回响，Jasmine 你还记得吗？

Afternoon.speaker: Jasmine
Afternoon.text_cn: 世界赠予我拥有 也赠予我回敬

Afternoon.speaker: Emeline
Afternoon.text_cn: 没错！世界赠予我们美好，也赋予我们回馈的机会。

Afternoon.speaker: Jasmine
Afternoon.text_cn: 现在，欢迎 东方歌舞团 合唱 《世界赠予我的》，用歌声为礼，致敬世界！

Afternoon.speaker: Emeline
Afternoon.text_cn:
The world gives us beauty and the chance to give back.
Now, please welcome Dongfang Arts Troupe performing “World Bestowed＂
using their voices as a gift to honor the world!

Afternoon.speaker: Esther
Afternoon.text_cn: 欢歌笑语，浓浓年味，拉近了我们彼此的距离

Afternoon.speaker: Jasmine
Afternoon.text_cn: 同心同行，情满舞台，凝聚的是里士满华人社区的团结与力量

Afternoon.speaker: Emeline
Afternoon.text_cn: 相聚相离，难忘今宵。感谢您对OCA-CVC的大力支持！

Afternoon.speaker: Amy
Afternoon.text_cn: 骏马奔腾迎福至， 祝大家春节愉快，阖家幸福，马年大吉！

Afternoon.speaker: 多多
Afternoon.text_cn: 乘骐骥以驰骋，一马平川，马到成功！

Afternoon.speaker: Evan
Afternoon.text_cn: 2026年春节联欢会到此圆满落幕，明年再见！

Afternoon.speaker: Chris
Afternoon.text_cn:
Joyful songs and laughter, 
Working together in unity, 
with hearts full of warmth on the stage, 
Thank you all for your strong support of OCA-CVC!

Afternoon.speaker: Jason
Afternoon.text_cn:
Wishing you a happy Lunar New Year and great fortune in the Year of the Horse!
The 2026 Spring Festival Gala concludes successfully here. See you next year!

Afternoon.speaker: All
Afternoon.text_cn: see you next year  明年再见！
